io.webagent4j.browsercrawler

Packages that use io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
Package
Description
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
A deterministic, bounded-concurrency browser crawler: JavaScript-rendered link discovery through a real browser session, reusing webagent4j-browser-api for navigation and webagent4j-wait for stability rather than a second wait/timing implementation.
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.internal
Engine internals for BrowserCrawler: the FIFO frontier, the synchronized claim gate, scope evaluation, DOM link discovery, page stability waiting, and URL normalization.

    BrowserCrawledPage
    One successfully navigated, stabilized page, with the links discovered in the rendered DOM during the observation taken immediately after stability was accepted.

    The reason a single page's navigation did not produce a BrowserCrawledPage.
    BrowserCrawlRequest
    Immutable, fully validated configuration for one IBrowserCrawler.crawl(BrowserCrawlRequest) call.

    BrowserCrawlTerminationReason
    Why a browser crawl stopped.
    CancellationToken
    A cooperative, thread-safe cancellation signal for a single BrowserCrawlRequest.
    FrameCrawlPolicy
    How a BrowserCrawler discovers links inside <iframe> documents, in addition to the top-level document of every crawled page.
    IBrowserCrawler
    A deterministic, bounded-concurrency crawler that discovers and navigates pages through a real browser, for content an HTTP crawler cannot render (JavaScript-rendered links, client-side navigation, authenticated sessions).
